blocks.text: Those Singhs who had gone out on errands hear the firing and return without hesitation, ready to die if needed beside their companions. The Singhs greeted the night as one greets a sunrise, because darkness weakens Mughal confidence while restoring freedom of movement to the Khalsa.

In that changed atmosphere, the fighting turns sharply. An exposed Mughal officer is struck down and the enemy line begins to lose its order, allowing the Singhs to convert a near-disaster into a night battle fought on more equal terms.

The page closes by stressing renewal rather than mere survival. Morning finds the Khalsa strengthened in spirit, and the battle at Mehtab Kot becomes another proof that persecution cannot extinguish their resolve.
